key.name: blur-strength
key.description: Background blur radius. Default 0 = solid dark style (no blur).

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the background fill (0 = transparent, 100 = solid). Default 100 = solid dark.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius used for the expanded surfaces (the dock capsule always uses a fully-rounded pill shape).

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Accent color used for the active tab indicator, focus ring and highlights. Any CSS color string. Default white = Apple Dynamic-Island style.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size (px) of the time/date text on the dock capsule.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family used for the dock clock, e.g. "Inter", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Cantarell" or "SF Pro Display".

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: How long the pointer must hover the dock before the quick toolbar appears.

key.name: suppress-banners
key.description: While FloeIsland is enabled, the default GNOME notification banners are suppressed so that all notifications are shown on the island instead.

key.name: notif-duration
key.description: How long each stacked notification stays on the island before switching to the next one.

key.name: notif-stack-depth
key.description: How many notifications are visible stacked behind the front one.

key.name: notif-anim-style
key.description: How the front notification leaves when the next one takes over: blur out, slide up, or scale out.

key.name: takeover-volume
key.description: Show volume changes on the island instead of the default OSD.

key.name: takeover-brightness
key.description: Show brightness changes on the island instead of the default OSD.

key.name: takeover-mute
key.description: Show mute / unmute feedback on the island instead of the default OSD.

key.name: takeover-airplane
key.description: Show airplane mode toggling on the island.

key.name: takeover-mic
key.description: Show microphone enable/disable feedback on the island.

key.name: takeover-recording
key.description: Show screen recording state on the island.

key.name: takeover-screenshot
key.description: Show a screenshot confirmation on the island.

key.name: module-messages
key.description: Show the recent-notifications list tab in the full panel.

key.name: module-weather
key.description: Show the weather tab in the full panel.

key.name: module-calendar
key.description: Show the lunar calendar tab in the full panel.

key.name: module-music
key.description: Show the MPRIS music player tab in the full panel.

key.name: module-timer
key.description: Show the countdown / stopwatch tab in the full panel.

key.name: module-translate
key.description: Show the quick-translation tab in the full panel.

key.name: weather-provider
key.description: wttr.in needs no API key; OpenWeatherMap requires a key in the weather-api-key setting.

key.name: weather-api-key
key.description: API key used by the OpenWeatherMap provider.

key.name: weather-city
key.description: City name used by the weather provider (e.g. Beijing). Empty = auto-detect (wttr.in by IP; OpenWeatherMap falls back to Beijing).

key.name: weather-unit
key.description: Metric (Celsius) or imperial (Fahrenheit).

key.name: search-backend
key.description: Backend used by the full-file search: tracker3, locate, a custom command, or apps only.

key.name: search-command
key.description: Custom command for the 'command' search backend. Every output line is shown as a result; you may use {q} as a placeholder for the query.

key.name: music-player
key.description: MPRIS bus name of the preferred player (e.g. org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify). Empty = use the first available player.

key.name: debug
key.description: Print verbose logs to the GNOME Shell journal (journalctl -f -o cat /usr/bin/gnome-shell).
